For agents:
Keep these headings and fill each section.
The three main sections are the author's pitch for this PR to reviewers.
Minimize the effort needed to read them: convey why the PR is worth reviewing with the fewest words that preserve the necessary information.

Summary: state what improves and why reviewers should care, ideally in one sentence.
Description of the change: give the minimum explanation needed to understand the approach and any material tradeoff. Use a small before/after example if it conveys this more efficiently. Do not repeat the summary or narrate the implementation.
For bug fixes, link an existing GitHub issue or put reproduction details in Additional details.
Validation: give the strongest relevant evidence from checks CI does not run, with just enough context to interpret it; write n/a if none. Omit results already reported by CI.
Additional details: put any remaining useful detail here and delete the block if empty. This section is usually not intended for humans to read.
Do not add an attribution footer, badge, or emoji signature.
-->
